params.prompt: Candid, high-quality iPhone mirror selfie taken inside a busy, real commercial gym in Mumbai. The subject is one adult woman in her late 20s: warm light-olive skin with faint natural freckles across her nose and upper cheeks, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, thick defined dark eyebrows, full lips in a natural mauve-nude colour, dark brown-black hair with copper balayage ends worn in a messy low bun with loose face-framing strands and a few flyaways, chunky silver hoop earrings. Curvy fitness-model build: narrow cinched waist with subtle visible abs, full bust, very full wide hips and high, round glutes, slim thighs, slim knees and calves. She wears a plain matte black bikini set with a supportive top and full-coverage bottoms, and clean white sneakers. She stands about two metres from the gym's large wall mirror, body turned slightly to a three-quarter angle, weight shifted onto one leg, in a relaxed, natural stance. She holds a black iPhone low at chest height in her right hand so her entire face stays clearly visible in the mirror reflection, and she looks at the phone screen with a warm, playful half-smile, caught mid-moment. The framing is slightly off-centre and slightly tilted, like a real phone selfie, showing her from head to mid-thigh in the mirror. Background in the mirror: a real working gym with a dumbbell rack, a flat bench, rubber floor tiles with scuff marks, a towel and a water bottle on the floor, cable machines, and other people blurred only by motion. Lighting: soft daylight from a large side window as the one main light source, with ordinary overhead gym lights, natural shadows, true-to-life colours. Shot on the iPhone main camera at 1x in standard photo mode, not portrait mode: natural deep depth of field with the background in focus, slight wide-angle phone perspective, crisp sharp detail, clean high-quality iPhone image with only faint natural noise in the shadows. Real unretouched skin with visible pores, fine peach fuzz, natural skin-tone variation and a matte finish; bare face with only natural lip colour and no glam makeup. Photorealistic photograph of a real person, one woman only, anatomically correct hands holding the phone, no text, no watermark, no logos, no brand names.
